subject.title: fix: gateway boots when a configured plugin payload is broken

question: Should gateway startup continue in a degraded state when a configured enabled plugin fails verified payload checks, rather than retain the current fail-closed readiness contract?
rationale: This is a compatibility and operational-policy choice: the same broken installation changes from a visible startup failure to a running gateway with an unavailable integration, and the linked canonical report is explicitly awaiting that decision.

options.title: Approve quarantine and boot
options.body: Accept the degraded-startup contract, then require a redacted built-gateway proof showing the affected plugin is skipped and readiness succeeds.

options.title: Retain fail-closed startup
options.body: Keep the merged diagnostic and remediation behavior from the earlier fix, and close this branch as an unapproved policy change.

recommendation.title: Approve quarantine and boot
recommendation.body: Accept the degraded-startup contract, then require a redacted built-gateway proof showing the affected plugin is skipped and readiness succeeds.

likelyOwner.reason: VACInc introduced the adjacent typed verification behavior and has the most direct merged-history context for the proposed follow-on contract.
